title: Bobby Martin leaves; heading home
summary: Bobby and Johnny Russell left early; Ramirez and Glyn Paque, Bass Hill remained, played Bern, then left as war fears rose.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: I'm not quite clear now. When did Bobby Martin go home? He left before you did.
Oh, well before. Yeah, he just left us there. From there, we went to Dancing Chiquita(?) in Bern. And from Bern, that's when we left.
That concluded it. He left first -- he and Johnny Russell. Left Glyn Paque, (?)Ernest (?), myself and Bass Hill there.
Well, they could see what was coming, I guess, after the Czech...
They had more fears than we did.
Yeah, Czechoslovakia, you know... So then, when you get home, what happens now?
